title: PPA agent handoff
description: The record of a deterministic pass explicitly waiving to an agent. It exists so that a handoff is auditable after the fact: which reason was claimed, what the program had already decided before it gave up, and which exact evidence context and policy were in force. A handoff that cannot be paired back to those is one nobody can review, and reviewability is the only thing that makes reaching a model acceptable at all.

reason.description: Closed set, spec 4.6. A reason outside it is refused rather than passed along, because an unenumerated reason is one no reviewer can weigh against the others.

question.description: What the agent is being asked. Checked against the never-delegated set at the moment the handoff is built, not at the moment the reason is chosen: no reason makes a never-delegated question delegable.

explain_only.description: True at B0 and A0. Stated in the handoff itself so the constraint travels with the request rather than living only in the sender.

handoff_sha256.description: Identity of this handoff, over the document without this key. It is what a returning proposal cites, which is what stops an agent answering an easier question than the one it was given.

program_already_decided.description: What the deterministic pass settled before waiving. Carried so a reviewer can ask the question that matters: could a rule have decided this?
